data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native post-unwrapping still life around exactly one source-faithful Prank-O My First Fire empty prank gift box in a warm living room, partially freed from torn cream wrapping paper and burgundy ribbon on a pale travertine table. Preserve the recognizable cream front, orange-brown My First Fire title, printed child beside the fake gray fire ring and flames, red feature list, printed fuel can and logs, dark fiery top edge, and teal right panel. Keep calm warm-plaster upper-quarter negative space for later typography. No added text, people, actual fire, fire parts, extra box, product card, CTA, price, badge, logo overlay, or watermark.
notes: The image endpoint returned moderation_blocked at the output stage and produced no artifact.
The source itself contains fixed child-and-flame package art, so the product pixels were not altered or regenerated after the failed call.
